work.summary: Digital photobook in MAXQ's Secret B series featuring Korean model and influencer Yoon Na-gyeom (윤나겸). RIDI identifies the specific product and its PDF format; Electronic Times identifies Yoon among the model-influencer participants in its 2022 Fitthy coverage. No cover image or PDF was copied because reuse permission is unconfirmed.
